name: TipRanks Financial Data
description:
TipRanks provides live financial data and analyst research for informational purposes. Tools cover: real-time stock quotes and price history; analyst consensus, price targets, and the proprietary Smart Score; financial statements, earnings history, estimates, and earnings-call summaries; dividends and stock splits; news and blogger sentiment; insider transactions; hedge-fund and congressional (politician) trading; ETF analysis, holdings, and screening; options activity; and cross-asset data for commodities, forex, crypto, and indices — plus market movers, sector and market performance, and economic, IPO, and FDA/clinical-trial calendars. Authenticated users can also read their own TipRanks portfolios (holdings, performance, and allocation).

All 70 tools are read-only — the connector never places trades or modifies accounts. Data is for informational purposes only and is not investment, financial, legal, or tax advice; quotes may be delayed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TipRanks Financial Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TipRanks Financial Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tipranks.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TipRanks Financial Data MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TipRanks Financial Data lists 70 MCP tools, including get_all_commodities_quotes, get_all_crypto_quotes, get_all_forex_quotes, get_analysts_by_firm, get_article, get_assets_data, get_assets_events, get_assets_news, get_assets_warnings, get_best_performing_experts, get_blogger_sentiment, and get_bulls_bears_summary.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TipRanks Financial Data?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to TipRanks Financial Data in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does TipRanks Financial Data MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: TipRanks Financial Data requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TipRanks Financial Data is developed by TipRanks. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
